title: $20/month of Claude Pro and solo dev: my tower defense is now on Google Play & Itchio
author: Williosz
selftext:
Hi, former web dev here, After lurking here for some time i always wondered how difficult it was a make using IA and well now i know. Literally all the code was written with Claude Code on the Pro plan using Godot 4. I just bought an asset packs that i like and voila. The game i made is a pirate remake of Wintermaul TD from warcraft 3: you build the maze with your towers.  
It even managed to help me make a PC version with co-op and 1v1 PvP and a mobile version too with solo campain.  
If there some people here wondering if they should give it a try, i assure you, its definitely possible, dont be scared to try like i was for so long !  
This project made me mentally convinced that i can tackle a bigger one and now i'm working on another project for steam.  
  
The mobile only contains the solo campain Google Play: [YarrrTD](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.willios.yarrrtd)  
For the curious of the pc version : [YarrrTD on PC](https://willios.itch.io/yarrrtd)

comments.author: Figure_431
comments.body:
The video looks incredible good and I love tower defense. I downloaded and played tutorial and first level. 

My impression is the game is not tested and not well thought. 

things I found
- tutorial screen focus on towers for teaching upgrade. it focuses on baricade which you cannot upgrade. it blocks the game till you replay or sell the baricade.
- the UX is super complex.
- starting game takes too long because the buttons don't show the units. so you have to gamble at first what unit you will use. 
- very small texts.
- sounds are really ugly and except repeating music, don't match with the theme.

I am not sure how much you except from the game but you have the most capable of tools under your hand.

replies.author: Williosz
replies.body:
Hey thanks for trying !

I actually had a lot of player test the game (20+) but we're warcraft veteran so we're used to it too much most likely 

I actually have never seen this barricade bug but it's an really nice find thanks man.

I have no idea how to make the UX easier to be fair

All the music are pirate theme made by a really good composer (everything in credits) I personally like them. The enemy sound I agree could have some work, I just enjoy the goofiness 

But really interesting reading you and it's good information.
I don't expect anything, I wanted to see if it was possible to make a game using IA assistance along the way and learn. If some people enjoy I'll be happy. Sold 3 copies on itchio which already seems unreal to me

replies.author: Figure_431
replies.body:
maybe i needed to describe better. the theme music is nice but sound effects are not. 

maybe chat with Claude a bit about the UI and UX. 

I am glad you already sold the game. hopefully you sell even more.

replies.author: Figure_431
replies.body: one more thing. i played on mobile

replies.author: Williosz
replies.body:
Mobile was tough man, i tried on 5 different phone and the outcome was always different, that was probably the most difficult part.  
I'll see what i can do and push an update to fix the problems you found already !

replies.author: Figure_431
replies.body: let me know. i can give another try.

comments.author: Williosz
comments.body: For now I got 80 download which is already more than I expect ! I believe it's saturated but I mostly wanted to finish a first project and learn
